name: Vistra Corp.
content: Vistra Corp. is a leading Fortune 500 integrated retail electricity and power generation company based in Irving, Texas. It operates a diverse portfolio of generation assets, including natural gas, nuclear, coal, solar, and battery energy storage facilities. Vistra is one of the largest competitive power generators in the United States and a major retail electricity provider, serving millions of residential, commercial, and industrial customers across multiple states. The company is increasingly focused on the energy transition through its Vistra Zero portfolio, which emphasizes zero-carbon generation and sustainable energy solutions.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

James A. Burke(Date: 2022 August)

President and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Burke has served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Vistra since August 2022. He previously served as President and Chief Financial Officer from December 2020 to August 2022, and as Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer from October 2016 to December 2020. Prior to the Vistra reorganization, he served as Chairman and CEO of TXU Energy.

Kristopher E. Moldovan(Date: 2022 August)

Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Moldovan has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since August 2022. He previously served as Senior Vice President and Treasurer from 2017 to 2022. He joined the company in 2006 and has held various leadership roles in finance and legal.

Stephen J. Muscato(Date: 2020 December)

Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer

Mr. Muscato has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer since December 2020. He previously served as Senior Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer from 2016 to 2020. He is responsible for the company's commercial operations, including power marketing and fuel supply.

Stephanie Zapata Moore(Date: 2016 October)

Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer

Ms. Moore has served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer since 2016. She is responsible for the company's legal and compliance functions. Prior to joining Vistra, she was Vice President and General Counsel of Luminant.

Scott A. Hudson(Date: 2016 October)

President, Vistra Retail

Mr. Hudson has served as President of Vistra Retail since 2016. He is responsible for the company's retail brands, including TXU Energy. He previously held leadership roles at TXU Energy and in the consulting industry.

Directors

Scott B. Helm(Date: 2022 January)

Chairman of the Board

Mr. Helm has served as Chairman of the Board since 2022 and as a director since 2016. He is a private investor and was previously a co-founder of Helm, Cullar & Hanley, LLC.

James A. Burke(Date: 2022 August)

Director

Mr. Burke is the President and CEO of Vistra. He joined the board in 2022 upon his appointment as CEO.

Arcilia Acosta(Date: 2020 February)

Independent Director

Ms. Acosta is the President and CEO of CARCON Industries and Construction. She has served on the board since 2020.

Lisa Crutchfield(Date: 2023 February)

Independent Director

Ms. Crutchfield is the Managing Principal of Hudson Strategic Advisers, LLC. She has served on the board since 2023.

Julie A. Lagacy(Date: 2023 February)

Independent Director

Ms. Lagacy previously served as Chief Sustainability and Strategy Officer at Caterpillar Inc. She joined the board in 2023.

John R. (Jack) Miller(Date: 2016 October)

Independent Director

Mr. Miller is the retired Chairman and CEO of North American Coffee Partnership. He has served on the board since 2016.
